chunks: Muḥammad ibn Muslim narrated from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام that he said:
There is no harm in performing salat (prayer) on any images or representations if you place them beneath you.

key_terms.جَعَلْتَهَا: you place them or put them
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; an expression of permissibility

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat (prayer) on a surface that has images or representations on it?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal ruling from Imam Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام regarding salat (prayer) in a place involving images or representations. It indicates permissibility when those representations are placed beneath the worshipper, making it relevant to prayer rulings and the conditions of the place of salat (prayer).
